title: Self-Assessment and Progress Review
description: The TDPO pauses at key points in the 30-day programme to assess their own progress honestly, identify gaps, and agree focus areas with their DPO. Professional standard means the TDPO can accurately identify their own weaknesses without prompting and articulate a specific plan to address them. These tasks are not graded — honest self-assessment is the only standard.

tasks.title: Self-Assessment — End of Foundation Phase
tasks.vessel_mode_execute: DP — sustained hold while conducting review
tasks.setup: Vessel on DP in calm conditions. Let the system run while you reflect.
tasks.execute: Hold position on DP. While the vessel holds, answer the following from memory without reference to notes. What have you learned in sessions 1 to 5 that surprised you? What skills feel genuinely confident? What feels uncertain? What questions remain unanswered? Discuss with your DPO at the end of the hold.
professional_standard: Honest assessment — not optimistic, not falsely modest
Specific skills named not vague categories
Agreed focus areas written down before ending the session

fields.label: Skills you feel genuinely confident about after days 1-5

debrief_questions: Are the skills you listed as confident ones you could demonstrate right now without preparation?
Are the skills you listed as weak ones you have actually practised or just read about?
Which of your unanswered questions is most important to resolve before the next phase?
What would a senior DPO say if they watched your best session from days 1 to 5?

tasks.title: Self-Assessment — Mid Programme
tasks.vessel_mode_execute: DP — sustained hold while conducting review
tasks.setup: Vessel on DP in moderate conditions. Run a sustained hold while you reflect.
tasks.execute: Hold position for 20 minutes. While monitoring the system, answer the following. Has your stopping distance improved since day 1? Has your approach discipline improved? Can you set up the simulator without reference in under 15 minutes? What can you do on day 15 that you could not do on day 1? Discuss with DPO.
professional_standard: Honest gap assessment relative to NI Simulator Course standard
Specific focus areas for days 16-25 agreed
No generic statements — specific evidence only

debrief_questions: Is the improvement you identified real and measurable or do you just feel more comfortable?
What is the single biggest gap between your current standard and the NI Simulator Course standard?

What does your DPO think your biggest weakness is — and do you agree?

tasks.title: Self-Assessment — Pre-Completion Review
tasks.vessel_mode_execute: DP — sustained hold while conducting review
tasks.setup: Vessel on DP. Run the system while you conduct this assessment.
tasks.execute: Hold position and reflect honestly. Are you ready for the NI Simulator Course — yes or no, with evidence. What is the one skill you are least confident about? What scenario would most expose that weakness? What is the one thing you most wish you had more time to practise? Discuss with DPO.
professional_standard: Honest yes or no to readiness question with evidence
One specific skill identified as weakest
Specific scenario identified as most exposing
Final five sessions have a concrete plan

tasks.title: Pre-Course Mock Oral Examination
tasks.vessel_mode_execute: DP — sustained hold while conducting review
tasks.setup: Vessel on DP in moderate conditions. DPO conducts a verbal knowledge check while the vessel holds position.
tasks.execute: Hold position on DP while your DPO asks a minimum of 12 questions across system knowledge, failure responses, operational decisions, ASOG application, and watchkeeping. Answer without notes. The NI Simulator Course is a practical skills course not an examination — this is preparation for a productive learning experience, not an exam drill.
professional_standard: Correct answer to minimum 10 of 12 questions
No single topic area completely blank
Confidence maintained throughout even when uncertain
